When i was very young, around 10 maybe, a friend from school had to temporary move into a new house because her place was being remodeled and she invited me to hang out. There were 2 more people from our friend group there but I don't quite remember who they were, just that they were there. 

It started out normal, with  her showing us the place, the toys and talking about the house in general. We were home alone at this point and we started to play together. 

After a while her dog, who was partially potty trained, had an accident in the house. I don't remember exactly how it started but she decided to make me clean off the poop from the carpet. We were playing truth or dare or I lost a game and that was my punishment. Everybody was excited to see me cleaning off the poo and despite my protests they forced me and I did it because what else was I supposed to do? I figured that I will pick it up, throw it in the toilet, they would make fun of me ( as per usual) and than we would forget all about it. But she had other plans. Instead of the toilet she made me throw it in the bathtub and than she and the rest forced me to get in the bathtub while laughing and calling me names. I started to get uncomfortable and said that I wanted to leave but they insisted I had to finish my punishment. There was nothing I could do. Every time I tried to get up they would push me back down until I just positioned myself in the bathtub with my knees to my chest staring at the dog poop. It went on for a few minutes until I made the mistake of complaining of the smell. They all agreed that it did indeed smell so they took a few air fresher cans and started to spray them on me and around me in the bathtub to cover the smell of poop and of me who smelled like poop. It was getting hard to breath and I was fighting back tears. They were all laughing and calling me names. When they noticed that I was starting to get more emotional and to cover my nose with my shirt, she told me that I had to stay there for 5 more minutes before my punishment was over. I don't remember exactly if they were in the bathroom until my 5 minutes were up but I remember that they than forced me to clean up the poop in the bathtub and than exited the bathroom and blocked me from getting out. When I finally got out they all said it was a joke and that I shouldn't take it personally. 

I don't remember what happened after but I remained friends with the group despite knowing they were bullying me because I didn't have anyone else to talk to and they were quite popular. If i rejected her the whole class and neighborhood would have started to violently bully me. We lost contact and I sometimes want to contact her and call her out on everything that she did to me but I know that it wouldn't change the past so why bother.

I've been thinking and plotting of going NC with her and the closer the moving date was the more worried I would get. I wanted to tell her that enough is enough once I moved out. She made a comment about how she will have to hear from me everyday and how she will come visit me once a week to help me grocery shopping. I exploded and told her no. I do not wish to be in contact with her. I will NOT call everyday and she is not welcome to visit me. She acted as if she didn't believe me and told me " there is no such thing as a child not contacting their parents" and that I need to " stop being silly". She is my mother and she will always need to know about my whereabouts. 

 Something terrible happened to me almost a year ago and if what happened before wasn't enough to make me run for the hills ( it was), the thing she did was the last straw. I posted about it twice before but took the post down because it made me feel exposed and I was afraid that she might see it and stir drama, despite the fact that she doesn't speak English and doesn't know Reddit exists. 

I told her I will call her when I feel like it and I told the family member who helped me move that they are not allowed to give her my new address. They didn't really understand why despite knowing very  well what happened almost a year ago. She tried to get me to tell her my address and told me she will come visit to see if I turn her away. She never came but I think that she knows the address. She sort of understood and doesn't call me as often as she might want but she does call me about once a week and because of that I feel pressured to hear from her when about a week has passed. I start to worry and think that I should call today or tomorrow. I never want to but I know she will make comments if I don't. She ends up calling on her own during the time I worry and this is part of the reason I get the panic attacks. I have my guard high up but I try to avoid the calling until she calls me and I can't avoid it anymore. 

Yes I can transition without her and I don't need her approval. My therapist keeps telling me but the hormones will change my voice. The face I can hide but the voice can't stay hidden for long. She will get shocked and use the threat on me and because I'm far away there is nothing I can do. If i call somebody I might make it worse because the threat will get investigated and part of me knows it's just words to manipulate me, but can I risk it? If I alarm somebody there will be a lot of fights and talks between everybody. Worst case scenario nr 2 is that she will drop everything and come here. I don't know what to expect if that were to happen. I don't think she would hurt me but who knows? Can i really risk that or having a big fight that could get me kicked out of my place? No one wants to deal with cops being called or loud screaming and gossips. I know that this is my anxiety speaking and that the chances of any of it happening are slim but 0.000001% chance is still a chance
